First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: party pace.
Check
Look at @sacramentobikeparty the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Bike Party Sacramento group ride

A big themed social ride on the first Friday of the month, rain or shine. Hundreds show up with lights, costumes and sound systems. Volunteers plan the route and theme; there are no official leaders, and you ride at your own risk. Start point changes each month and is posted on Facebook and Instagram.
